analyzer_provenance.multimodal_frame_review: 52 timestamped frames (3.0s stride, 0.0s-153.0s) across 3 contact sheets visually inspected

signal_candidates.note: Frequent 10-15 frame cross-dissolves suppress single-frame FFmpeg scene scores; OpenCV sustained-change + abrupt candidates + visual frame inspection capture real vignette transitions.

01_narrative_structure_and_hook.hook_0_5s: Protagonist wakes up stretching on a purple bed in a cozy striped bedroom (00:00s) and opens the front door (00:03s) as second-person narration ('Kamu...') immediately places the viewer inside everyday public infrastructure.

sequence_breakdown.beat: Bedroom wake-up & stepping out front door hook
Road asphalt thickness audit (RAB), ministry turnover & official inauguration stage
Traffic light countdown, Bappenas planning headache & 65-trillion congestion loss billboard
School curriculum churn, Puskesmas queue & 1-doctor-to-crowd ratio visualization
Agriculture paddy field, chili price shock, official convoy vs citizen motorbike & 10kg social aid scale
Resignation ethics, courtroom/prison chess satire, World Corruption Perception Report Card (34/100) & historical integrity contrast (Kabinet Djuanda / exemplary police vignette)
Election campaign contrast (track-record candidate vs 100-day billboard populist), citizen as HRD interviewer & ballot booth dilemma
Circular callback: waking up on the exact same bed (150.0s) and stepping outside the house (153.0s)

02_shots_timestamps_and_pacing.rhythm_notes: Rapid montage of 2.5-4.0s visual gags inside each topical vignette, bridged by soft cross-dissolves between ministries/locations and punctuated by 9 brief breath pauses.

03_characters_and_acting.protagonist: Recurring everyday citizen in teal shirt and dark trousers acting as audience surrogate (observer, commuter, voter, HRD interviewer).
03_characters_and_acting.ensemble_archetypes: Modular stylized cast differentiated immediately by silhouette props: yellow hard-hat inspector, glasses-and-peci ministers, white-coat doctors, caping farmer, black-robed judge, campaign candidates.
03_characters_and_acting.acting_style: Deadpan institutional staging contrasted with exaggerated cartoon reaction beats (hands on head in traffic, sweat-drop grimace in ballot booth).

04_body_motion_facial_expressions_and_ob.proportions: Spherical head (~0.35 body height) with slender cylindrical rubber-hose limbs.
04_body_motion_facial_expressions_and_ob.facial_system: 2D-projected expressive brow/eye/mouth states (wide-eyed shock, squinted frustration, clenched-teeth grimace, glasses specular flash).
04_body_motion_facial_expressions_and_ob.object_interaction: Clear prop-driven storytelling: measuring ruler on asphalt, motorcycle handlebars, weighing scale reading 10 kg, chess board in cell, ballot paper.

05_camera_and_cinematography.camera_motion: Gentle linear dolly push-ins/pull-backs and lateral slides; minimal handheld shake.

06_environment_assets_materials_and_ligh.environments: Modular Indonesian civic & domestic dioramas (bedroom, suburban street, ministry facade, classroom, Puskesmas, rice paddy, market, courtroom, rally stage, polling booth).
06_environment_assets_materials_and_ligh.materials: Clean matte/semi-matte stylized PBR surfaces (roughness ~0.45-0.85) with crisp readability and low texture noise.
06_environment_assets_materials_and_ligh.lighting: Warm practical lamp glow for bedroom/archive scenes; clean bright tropical sun-sky daylight for street/rally exteriors; theatrical volumetric cone spotlight for satirical stage metaphors.

07_technical_cutaways_and_demonstrations.diegetic_data_staging: Data and statistics are built as physical in-world 3D props rather than flat 2D slides: 'RAPOR DUNIA: INDEKS PERSEPSI KORUPSI 34/100' classroom board, '1 DOKTER' surrounded by hundreds of 3D citizen pegs, 'KERUGIAN MACET 65 TRILIUN' street billboard, and 'DETIK MERAH 30' traffic timer.

08_captions_and_typography.export_cleanliness: Direct clean 9:16 master export without social-platform UI chrome.
08_captions_and_typography.subtitle_style: Word-by-word / short-token dynamic captions (1-2 words per cue) centered at ~78% vertical height, bold white geometric sans-serif with thick black outline and soft drop shadow.
08_captions_and_typography.in_scene_signage: High-contrast uppercase Indonesian institutional signage ('KEMENTERIAN', 'PUSKESMAS', 'RAPOR DUNIA', 'SURAT SUARA') readable on mobile screens.

09_narration_audio_and_sfx.delivery: Continuous, brisk conversational Indonesian second-person voiceover (-14.8 LUFS integrated, tight 4.2 LU dynamic range) with minimal dead air (only 3.6s silence >250ms across 154.6s).
09_narration_audio_and_sfx.mix_observations: Steady background music bed tucked beneath forward vocal presence, accented by subtle transitional and comedic beats.
09_narration_audio_and_sfx.unverified_audio_boundaries: Full verbatim ASR transcript and separated audio stems are intentionally not claimed or reproduced.

10_editing_transitions_and_vfx.transitions: Hybrid editing: hard cuts inside a location, 10-15 frame cross-dissolves across topical/scene shifts (visible at 06.0s, 21.0s, 36.0s, 135.0s).
10_editing_transitions_and_vfx.vfx: Volumetric stage light cones, glasses lens-gleam highlight (01:18s), 2D comic thought-bubble ('?', 01:00s), and foreground blur rack-focus (01:45s).
